takes.text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, handheld night footage. A tiny corner shop at 2 a.m., fluorescent tubes flickering over shelves of crisps and bottled drinks. The camera holds a static shot. A tired young man in a rain-soaked hoodie puts a carton of oat milk on the counter. Behind the counter an old cashier with reading glasses scans it without looking up, a red panda asleep next to the till. The customer with a tired young male voice (S1) says: <d>[German] Ist das Ihr Tier?</d> The cashier with a gravelly old female voice (S2) says: <d>[German] Der wohnt hier.</d>

overall_soundscape: Fluorescent tubes buzz and rain drums on the shop window.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
picks: {Nein, das ist der Chef.|Der wohnt hier.|Welches Tier?}
{Nein, das ist der Chef.|Der wohnt hier.|Welches Tier?}=Der wohnt hier.
